STEP 2 (Round 88): Freeze L3-BENCHMARK-005 (pure displacement, (K/2)(ln J)^2 volumetric, both solvers). All 9 fields.
STEP 3 (Round 89): Run SfePy at >= 10 points along loading path. Verify trajectory shape (monotonicity, curvature).
STEP 4 (Round 89): Rebuild FEBio. Configure with uncoupled neo-Hookean (or user material) to match (K/2)(ln J)^2 volumetric in pure displacement.
STEP 5 (Round 89): Run FEBio at >= 10 points along loading path.
STEP 6 (Round 90): Three-way comparison: Analytical ↔ FEBio ↔ SfePy, at >= 10 points, for stress AND tangent. Check trajectory shape.
STEP 7 (Round 90): If all 9 checks pass AND three-way agreement within tolerance: L3-PASS.

important_caveat: This audit represents PROGRESS toward L3, not L3-PASS. The CEAT-GATE-001 v2.1.0 still REFUSES L3 on 4 of 9 checks.
